expected: The tracker snapshot must reference committed source bytes and the consistency checker must return errorCount=0 without altering application behavior or lowering a gate.
actual: Refreshed 77 source snapshot records to exact committed blobs at the P2 source SHA, restored CHANGE-20261002-0352.beforeHash from CHANGE-20261002-0347.afterHash, and reran the checker: errorCount=0; exact source inventory 916/916. No application source changed in this ledger-only step.
notes: This proves ledger consistency against the local committed source tree only. It is not an Ubuntu Node 22 CI result, a GitHub Actions run, backend/staging verification, UI acceptance or production certification.
